title: Sales Advisor – Kia PBV
company: Allen Motor Group – Kia PBV Milton Keynes
pay: £23,453 basic / £40,000 OTE + uncapped commission, bonus & company vehicle
fit: Posted 26 Nov: automotive or B2B sales experience is 'beneficial', not required, and £40k OTE is above your target. Your Curve Media prospecting of business owners suits selling Kia's business vans to companies.
desc: Sell Kia's Professional Business Vehicles (PBV) range to business customers at Allen's Milton Keynes Kia PBV centre, reporting to the CV Sales Manager. Handle face-to-face, phone and online enquiries, build relationships with business customers, recommend vehicle solutions, prospect for new business, hit targets, learn the PBV range, keep records and follow company and Kia processes. They want strong communication, organisation, IT and customer skills and a motivated attitude. Full time, 42.5 hours, 5 days Monday to Saturday.
cover:
Hi Allen Motor Group recruitment team,

I'd like to apply for the Sales Advisor role at Kia PBV Milton Keynes. My CV is attached.

I work at BCA in Bedford, handling dealership drop-offs and collections, MOT and service movements, vehicle preparation and customer handovers, so I deal with dealerships and customers' vehicles every day.

Before that I spent over a year in business-to-business sales at Curve Media, finding my own leads through cold calls and email, building relationships with business owners and closing premium packages. I haven't sold vehicles yet, but prospecting businesses, following up and closing is what I did daily, and I'd love to bring that to Kia's PBV range.

I'd welcome the chance to learn from your team.

Kind regards,
Rougier Williams
07407 433797
prep:
30-SECOND PITCH
I work at BCA with dealerships every day – drop-offs, MOT and service movements, handovers – and before that I did B2B sales at Curve Media, cold calling and emailing business owners and closing premium packages. I haven't sold vehicles yet, but finding business customers and closing is what I know, and I want to learn the PBV range properly.

LIKELY QUESTIONS
• Why commercial vehicles? Business customers buy on need and value – like your Curve Media clients.
• How would you find new business? Call local trades and fleets, follow up by email, use referrals.
• Tell me about a sale you closed. A real Curve Media deal: the lead, the objection, the close.
• How do you handle targets? Curve Media was target-driven; you ran your own pipeline.
• What do you know about Kia PBV? Kia's new electric van range, starting with the PV5.
• Saturdays? Mon–Sat, 5-day week – say yes if you can.

ASK THEM
• What training do new advisors get on the PBV range and finance?
• How much business comes from inbound enquiries versus prospecting?

RESEARCH
Kia PV5 models, range and price; Allen's other Milton Keynes sites (Kia, Chery, OMODA).
checkNote: Page live with apply button + listed on Allen careers homepage
